capabilities: Generate a Daf Yomi note by date or by tractate/page via commands
Insert links to daily PDFs and commentaries (Steinsaltz, Sefaria, Daf Yomi Digest, Hadran)
Download the day's Steinsaltz Talmud PDF and embed it in the note
Create a tractate summary page linking to every Daf page
Configure directory, file name, and title templates
extras: Links are generated without checking availability, so past dates more than a few weeks old or future dates may yield broken links; the author expects fixes to be needed at the start of each new tractate. The README encourages donations to the resource organizations (Steinsaltz Center, Sefaria, My Jewish Learning) and directs ongoing news to an Obsidian Forum thread.
motivation: The author uses these specific resources daily and built the plugin to prepare the day's Daf note for himself, inviting others to request additional resources.
problem: Daf Yomi participants must manually locate each day's Talmud page and gather links to PDFs and commentaries from multiple sites; the plugin automates creating that note in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: I mostly followed obsidian-pluck as a nice example.

summary: Daf Yomi study helper that generates a templated daily note for each page of the Talmud schedule, with links to and downloads of commentaries and PDFs.
